title: The File That Survived a Broken Computer
title_ja: 壊れたパソコンから守られたファイル
fact_notes: 登場人物、具体的な出来事・観察・記録は架空の教材例。実在の調査結果ではない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: A group of students spent several weeks preparing a digital magazine for their school festival.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちは学校祭のデジタル雑誌の準備に数週間を費やした。

sentences.en: They wrote articles, designed the pages, and collected drawings from different clubs.
sentences.ja: 記事を書き、ページをデザインし、各部活動から絵を集めた。

sentences.en: Their editor stored the latest version of the magazine on a single classroom computer.
sentences.ja: 編集担当者は雑誌の最新版を教室の一台のパソコンに保存した。

sentences.en: Everyone believed that having the file in one familiar place would make the work easier.
sentences.ja: 全員が慣れた一か所にファイルがあれば作業が容易になると考えた。

sentences.en: One morning, the computer refused to start, and the editor could not open the magazine.
sentences.ja: ある朝、パソコンが起動せず編集担当者は雑誌を開けなかった。

sentences.en: The students had saved copies of several early articles, but these did not include the final changes.
sentences.ja: 初期の記事のコピーはいくつか保存していたが、最終変更は含まれていなかった。

sentences.en: A teacher helped them find a recent copy on another approved school device.
sentences.ja: 教師は別の学校公認端末にある最近のコピーを見つけるのを手伝った。

sentences.en: Although some edits were missing, the group was able to rebuild the magazine before the festival.
sentences.ja: 一部の編集は失われていたが、学校祭前に雑誌を再構築できた。

sentences.en: Afterward, the students examined how they had managed their files during the project.
sentences.ja: その後、生徒たちは活動中のファイル管理方法を調べた。

sentences.en: They realized that a backup was useful only if it contained the information they actually needed.
sentences.ja: バックアップは実際に必要な情報を含んでいる場合にのみ役立つと気づいた。

sentences.en: They also needed to know which copy was current and who was allowed to update it.
sentences.ja: どのコピーが最新で誰が更新を許可されているかも把握する必要があった。

sentences.en: Simply creating many copies without a system could lead to additional confusion.
sentences.ja: 仕組みなく大量のコピーを作るだけでは混乱が増え得る。

sentences.en: The team agreed to save dated backups in a separate approved location after major changes.
sentences.ja: チームは重要な変更後に日付付きバックアップを別の許可された場所に保存することにした。

sentences.en: They tested whether a backup could be opened and used on another classroom device.
sentences.ja: バックアップを別の教室端末で開いて使えるか試した。

sentences.en: However, they avoided putting material containing private information in an unrestricted folder.
sentences.ja: ただし個人情報を含む資料をアクセス制限のないフォルダに置くことは避けた。

sentences.en: Their teacher checked that the new procedure followed school rules for handling files.
sentences.ja: 教師は新しい手順が学校のファイル取扱規則に従うことを確認した。

sentences.en: The students learned that saving a file and being able to recover it were different achievements.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちは保存することと復元できることが別の成果だと学んだ。

sentences.en: A reliable process required both preparation and a practical test before a problem occurred.
sentences.ja: 信頼できる手順には問題発生前の準備と実際のテストの両方が必要だった。

sentences.en: Their experience made them less dependent on any single device during future projects.
sentences.ja: この経験により今後の活動で特定の一台の端末への依存が減った。

sentences.en: They now considered recovery part of creating digital work, rather than an emergency task to think about later.
sentences.ja: 復元を後で考える緊急作業ではなく、デジタル作品制作の一部と考えるようになった。

at the end of a process

questions.explanation_ja: 学校祭のデジタル雑誌。

questions.prompt: Where was the latest version originally stored?
questions.explanation_ja: 教室の一台のパソコン。

options: By finding a recent copy on another approved device.
By buying a new school building.
questions.explanation_ja: 最近のコピーを発見した。

questions.prompt: Why is a large number of copies not sufficient?
options: Every copy must be shared publicly.
Only the oldest copy is useful.
Copies must be useful and their versions must be managed.
More copies always cause data loss.
questions.explanation_ja: 内容と版の管理が重要。

questions.prompt: When did the team plan to save dated backups?
options: Before writing any content at all.
Whether school computers could play music.
Whether a backup worked on another device.
Whether the magazine could be sold.
Whether the teacher could write faster.
questions.explanation_ja: 他端末で復元できるか試した。

questions.prompt: Why did they avoid unrestricted folders for private material?
options: To protect information from unauthorized access.
To make backups impossible to use.
To prevent teachers from checking rules.
To increase the number of copies.
questions.explanation_ja: 個人情報を保護するため。

questions.prompt: What lesson did the students learn?
options: A familiar computer can never fail.
Saving a file guarantees its recovery.
Plan and test recovery as part of digital work.
All school files should be public.
questions.explanation_ja: 復元の準備とテストを制作に組み込む。

paraphrases.explanation_ja: 一か所の保存が作業を簡単にすると期待。

paraphrases.source: Although some edits were missing, the group was able to rebuild the magazine before the festival.
paraphrases.rewrite: Despite losing a few revisions, they reconstructed the magazine in time.
